stderr 'comptime::method_value'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/promotediface

go 1.27

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Box[T any] struct {
	V int
}

func (b Box[T]) Count() int {
	n := 0
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		_ = f.Name
		n++
	}
	return n + b.V
}

type Pair struct {
	A int
	B string
}

type Counter interface {
	Count() int
}

func main() {
	s := struct{ Box[Pair] }{Box[Pair]{V: 5}}
	var c Counter = s
	fmt.Println(c.Count())
}
